newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 9.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Youth minister urges youth on farm projects to double effort to help Ivory Coast eliminate 300,000 tonne rice deficit.
- Senior army officers write to President Bedie to protest against draft law providing for police searches of homes as part of crackdown on violent crime.
- Three opposition journalists serving jail terms on charges of insulting the head of state appear in court this morning for bail hearing.

- Government plans to expand Abidjan and San Pedro ports appear to have been set aside despite increased role of the two ports in Ivory Coast's trade, according to article reproduced from trade magazine Marches Tropicaux.
